g.text: SD12 — Flee from Combat or Leave a Conversation (UC04 5b, UC03 step 7; F04, F03; Command, State)
(n1) proposal = new ActionProposal(FLEE or LEAVE, null, null). Typed "flee" also arrives through SD02; the CLI's "leave" calls performAction(), so it never reaches sendDialogue()
SD03 — mode check: allows(FLEE) is true only in CombatMode,
